scope: Owner request 2026-10-31: "We're seeking to publish a demo of this game next week for Roshan. We're going to place a cap on new development, it's okay if part 2 doesn't completely resolve at this point. With that said, identify priorities to work through before a demo, identify areas of needed improvement and work to develop plan to implement these changes. Provide analysis of high priority fixes in handoff for codex". Claude delivers a written Codex handoff (no game change, no images, no probe run): a demo definition, a feature freeze, ranked priorities and work packages DR0-DR7 with acceptance criteria, a one-week schedule, owner questions Q1-Q8 with defaults, a code-anchored audit of the Day One route, Part 2 reachability and the release pipeline, a release and demo-day runbook, and post-demo improvement areas. Two confirmed child-facing defects are opened as canonical findings (MA-VIS-011 story clips under the black cover; MA-SAVE-002 upgraded career stars shown as un-earned) and four existing findings gain dated history. Benefit: the family's first device and child session gets a rehearsed, promoted build without a black climax, a grown-up menu or a lost save. Revision 2 (same day): the owner answered "Use the defaults" to the eight questions; the answers and the freeze are recorded as nine ODR-DEMO-*-20261031 decisions through tools/record_owner_decision.py (cycle demo-readiness-20261031), and the README, audit, master-audit index and ledger note the answers. The Q2 canon edit and the Q7 protected-file restore needed an explicit yes that was not given, so CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md and assets/book/ are untouched.
